name: Quick Store Rotation
note: Optional one-minute shop rotation override, offers last six minutes.

name: Wheel Offset Presets
note: Shows the native Wide wheel offsets and adds ten 5 mm wider pairs.

name: Live Settings
note: Enable the optional live settings bridge for the next game launch.

note: Enables pressing ○ to skip the intro movie that plays when starting a new game

name: Debug environment
note: Changes the internal build environment to expose additional demo, LAN, B-Spec, and car settings.
